from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import re
import os

train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/en_train.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/en_sample_submission_2.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/en_test_2.csv")

# Check file existence
files_exist = [
    os.path.exists(f) for f in ["./input/en_train.csv", "./input/en_test_2.csv"]
]
print("Data loaded successfully:", sum(files_exist))


# Create features using the 'before' column
# Token normalization tasks often depend on surrounding context
def create_token_features(before_text):
    # Simple feature creation based on character context
    chars = list(before_text)

    # Create trigram features
    trigrams = []
    for i in range(len(chars) - 2):
        trigrams.append("".join(chars[i : i + 3]))

    return trigrams


# Vectorize features

y_train = train_df["after"]
X_test = test_df["before"]

# Apply TfidfVectorizer for character-level features
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="char_wb", max_features=100000, min_df=0.01)
X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_test)

# Split for validation (hold-out set not used in training)

)

# Train model

accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val_test, y_pred_valid)

# Generate predictions for full test set

# Format submission

sub_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

# Verify submission created

else:
